name: smwmusic-kil-iru
title: Kil - Iru
description:
Port of a beaultiful and mystical composition written by Kil, played in the famous Talkhaus collab hack A Super Mario Thing, in 2010.
It's played on the "Trial of Iron" level, in one of the first teleports.


Define option
How this song was written during an old era of Addmusic, it does uses an older version of @2, where it does sound quite different from the modern / default versions. Knowing that, there's an option to use this older @2 sample, or use the SMW default @2 sample. If you want to use this older @2 sample (for whatever reason), open the text file, and change the "Use_Older_@2" define value to anything, other than 0.
